headline: Explore your options
primaryText: Going the extra mile to find your perfect yacht.
whyItWorks: A large superyacht photo on a calm sea signals the premium lifestyle at a glance, while the dark teal panel and bright logo keep the brand easy to spot. The promise of personal effort speaks to buyers who expect a concierge-level service. A single low-pressure enquiry button gives high-value prospects an easy first step, and the ad was still being shown the day before capture.
